[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26652321/7fd000e8a6b639db4dd5b6feaeb86bf999f63b04.png[/img]

notes.title: Addressing a few issues.
notes.content:
Over the past few days we've received some feedback about Stifled and we'd like to address them here and keep everyone updated!

[b]Controller Support[/b]
You can only have one controller attached at one point.
[list]
    [*]Xbox Game Pad - Supported
    [*]Oculus Touch - Supported
    [*]HTC Vive Steam Controllers - Currently in Review
[/list]

[b]Optimisation Issues[/b]
[list]
    [*]We seem to have issues with Nvidia 700 series cards
    [*]There are complains about VR performance as well.
    [*]We're in the midst of narrowing down these issues and will hopefully have an update soon.
[/list]

Thanks for all the support and feedback! It's has been really helpful and humbling!

notes.title: Help us out pre-launch!

Hey Stifled fans!

We are super close to the launch of Stifled and we need some help to tell Steam that you care about Stifled by doing 2 things.

[olist]
    [*][b]Wishlisting Stifled if you haven't already[/b]

    [*][b]Tagging Stifled with a the following of tags[/b]
[i]Horror, Stealth, Survival, Story Rich, Atmospheric, Experimental, VR, Indie, Psychological Horror, Dark, Adventure, Thriller, Survival Horror, Sci-fi, Surreal[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26652321/553fb6cc9c9c16b902d6a2e25f813a4936357aad.png[/img]

[/olist]

Thanks again for your patience!
-Justin

notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hey Stifled fans!

Just wanted to quickly leave a note to say that Stifled is coming to PC super soon.

We're putting the final touches on the game, making sure translations are in right, the game is playable on all the promised platforms, and sorting out our launch announcement.

We couldn't talk about any of these for the past 6 months because of our exclusivity with Sony, but rest assured, Stifled is coming.

Thank you so much for your interest and continued support despite our lack of updates. Please be patient as we make sure the game is ready.

In the meantime, you're more than welcomed to check out Muffled Warfare! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/545180/Muffled_Warfare

-Justin
